title: Microsoft Teams: external presenters can control event production tools
summary: Hold: the licensing field says entitlement is unpublished even though Microsoft's licensing page explicitly includes production controls in Advanced event features and names the eligible organiser licences. The organiser controls, rollout dates and policy commands are supported; the external presenter's own licence requirement remains unpublished.

Replace licensing.notes with: 'Production controls are included in Advanced event features, with event capabilities determined by the organiser licence; enterprise licences listed are Office 365 E1, E3, E5 and Microsoft 365 E3, E5, E7.
